messages:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — panel for backend SWE candidate (L3) tomorrow 11:00am PST. Need a debrief lead + rubric owner. Anyone able to scribe and own the rubric?
Morgan Lee: I can scribe, but I have a calendar conflict at 11:30. Happy to capture first 30 mins and summarize. :thumbsup:
Talia R.: I can be rubric owner and prep evaluation anchors. Will focus on system design and code quality buckets. @Ben Ortiz are you able to cover infra/design?
Ben Ortiz: I can join for system design. 11:00 → 11:15 start is okay for me (have a brief at 10:30). Also — which rubric version are we using?
Alex Kim: Using rubric v2.1 (devx team variant). Quick link: https://redwood.internal/rubrics/v2.1 ; main changes: heavier weight on design tradeoffs + safety checks.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — debrief checklist + recording permission ping 30 mins before meeting.
Morgan Lee: Quick question — do we need explicit candidate consent for recording? I can message candidate now if needed.
Talia R.: Yes, please ping. Also adding a short normalization note: weight system design 40%, implementation 35%, collaboration 25%. Attaching anchors doc in thread.
Ben Ortiz: Dropping a short scoring snippet for scribe to copy into notes:
```
Design: /10
Implementation: /10
Collab/Prod: /10
Overall: /10
Notes: <freeform>
```
Ben Ortiz: And a note — emphasize follow-up question about latency tradeoffs and caching.
Alex Kim: Thanks — I'll update the calendar invite to list scribe (Morgan) and rubric owner (Talia). I'll also book a 15-min buffer after the interview for the debrief. :wave:
Morgan Lee: I'll prep buffer questions and share a short prompt set in the thread by EOD.
Talia R.: Anchors uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/anchors_l3_v2.1 — added examples for strong/weak answers. @people-ops-bot can you post the debrief form link after the panel ends?
people-ops-bot: Debrief form will be posted after the meeting: https://redwood.in/debrief/form?id=xyz — recording permission and candidate consent: please confirm before starting.
Alex Kim: Great — if anyone can't make it, callout ASAP and we'll swap. Otherwise, I think we're good. Thanks all.
Morgan Lee: Got it — pinging candidate now re: recording.
Talia R.: I'll bring normalization doc to the debrief.
Ben Ortiz: LGTM. See you tomorrow.
